column1: 30201§divest§daɪˈvest§v. 去除；剥去（某物身上的…）；剥离（资产）；撤资§The great men of culture are those who have had a passion for diffusing, for making prevail, for carrying from one end of society to the other, the best knowledge, the best ideas of their time; who have labored to divest knowledge of all that was harsh, uncouth, difficult, abstract, professional, exclusive; to humanise it, to make it efficient outside the clique of the cultivated and learned, yet still remaining the best knowledge and thought of the time, and a true source, therefore, of sweetness and light.§文化伟人热衷于传播：把时代最好的知识与思想从社会的一端送到另一端；他们努力**剥去**知识身上生硬、粗鄙、艰深、抽象、专业化、排他的一切，使它人文化，使它能在有学养者的小圈子之外同样生效，却仍不失为时代最好的知识与思想，并因此成为「甜美与光明」的真正源泉。§§§§divest X of Y 去除 X 身上附着的 Y§反义 invest；前缀 di-/dis- 表「去掉」§

30202§drape§dreɪp§v. （布、帘）松垂地披覆；悬挂；把…搭在…上 n. 窗帘；帷幔§… those heavy curtains draped so as to half exclude the light of the sun.§……那些厚重的窗帘**垂挂**着，恰好挡去一半的阳光。§§§§drape A over B 把 A 搭在 B 上；drapery n. 帷幔；布帘§§改译文：英文只是末句片段，删去英文里没有的前文

30203§emanate§ˈeməneɪt§v. 源自；发源于；（光、气味、声音）散发；放射§Citing cases as distinct as Jamaica and Mauritius, proponents of modernization theory hold the inverse, that so called Weberian bureaucracies emanate from capitalist growth.§现代化理论的支持者以牙买加、毛里求斯等迥异的案例为据，持相反观点：所谓韦伯式官僚体制**源自**资本主义增长。§§§§emanate from 由…产生；从…发出；emanation n. 散发（物）；originate / stem from 起源于（近义）§emanate ≠ emancipate：后者是「解放」，形近异义§

30204§emboss§ɪmˈbɒs§v. 在…上压印凸起图案；使凸起；以浮雕装饰§… those embossed, but sombre wallpapers hung up; those heavy curtains draped so as to half exclude the light of the sun.§……那些**压花**却阴沉的墙纸挂了起来；那些厚重的窗帘垂挂着，恰好挡去一半的阳光。§§§em-（使…进入）+ boss（凸起）→ emboss；n. embossing 浮雕工艺§embossed wallpapers 压花墙纸§§改译文：英文只是末尾两个分句，删去英文里没有的前文

30205§empirically§ɪmˈpɪrɪkli§adv. 以经验为依据地；实证地§In each country, unidirectional cycles among two, three, or four locations were empirically the most common pattern types; the graph shows each of these pattern types as a proportion of all pattern instances found for that country (e.g., the measured value for CI 3 in the graph, 0.12, indicates that the three-location pattern constituted 12% of all pattern instances in the Côte d’Ivoire data).§在每个国家，两、三或四地之间的单向循环**在经验上**都是最常见的模式类型；图中把这些模式类型各自占该国全部模式实例的比例展示了出来（例如图中 CI 3 的数值 0.12，表示三地模式占科特迪瓦数据全部模式实例的12%）。§Indeed, Susan Silbey has observed that "the meaning of the word 'culture'. is unstable." This uncertainty impedes formulating empirically testable claims about reality, which should be an aim of sociological research—a standard definition of culture is a worthy goal even if impossible to achieve, for the closer we come to one, the closer we come to reducing conceptual incoherence in the field.§的确，Susan Silbey 观察到：「『文化』一词的含义是不稳定的。」这种不确定性妨碍了提出可**实证**检验的现实主张——这本应是社会学研究的目标；为文化确立一个标准定义即使不可能实现，也是值得追求的目标：离它越近，就越能减少该领域的概念混乱。§§empirically testable 可实证检验的；empirical adj. 实证的；empiricism n. 经验主义§empirically（靠观测实证）≠ theoretically（靠理论推演），SAT 科学类文章核心对立；与 empire 只是形近，并不同源§改例句2：破折号后删去零宽字符，one, 后补空格；原书错：搭配说明称 empirically 与 empire 词源同根，实则前者出自希腊语 empeiria（经验），后者出自拉丁语 imperium

30206§enigmatic§ˌenɪɡˈmætɪk§adj. 神秘莫测的；难以索解的；谜一般的§Identification of consecutive riddles’ boundaries based on content is difficult, given their purposely enigmatic nature, the challenges modern readers face in interpreting the archaic language of Old English, and damage to the manuscript.§要依据内容判定相邻谜语的分界很难：它们本就刻意写得**玄秘**，现代读者解读古英语又障碍重重，加上手稿本身还有残损。§§§enigma n. 谜 → enigmatic adj.§§§

30207§enliven§ɪnˈlaɪvn§v. 使活跃；使生动；使更有生气§The moss in the towering water oaks had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver and hung like festoons of carnival or like funeral decorations for the mourning of the dead.§高大的水栎上的苔藓被一层银中带翠的润泽**点亮**，像狂欢节的彩饰，又像为悼亡而悬挂的丧礼装饰，垂挂下来。§§§en-（使）+ live（活的）+ -n§enliven the party / the discussion 使聚会 / 讨论活跃起来；enlivened adj. 被点亮的；被赋予生气的；liven up 使热闹起来（口语近义）§enliven ≠ enlighten：后者是「启发、开导」，形近异义§

30208§entice§ɪnˈtaɪs§v. 引诱；诱使；吸引§External shopping cues are a type of marketing that uses obvious messaging—a display featuring a new product, for example, or a "buy one, get one free" offer—to entice consumers to make spontaneous purchases.§外部购物线索是一类营销手段，用醒目的信息——比如陈列新品，或「买一送一」——**诱使**消费者临时起意下单。§To entice study participants, psychology researchers commonly offer a gift card or other compensation.§为**吸引**研究参与者，心理学研究者通常会赠送礼品卡或提供其他报酬。§§entice sb into sth / to do sth 诱使某人（做）某事；enticement n. 诱惑物§与 lure 相比更偏「用好处打动」§改例句：两处破折号录入丢失（messaging a display、offer-to），补回 —

30209§ephemeral§ɪˈfemərəl§adj. 短暂的；转瞬即逝的；（昆虫）朝生暮死的§Stenography's rapidly inscribed squiggles and dots would enable (in theory, at least) the precise capture in print of improvisations by performers that would otherwise be ephemeral.§速记术那些迅速写下的潦草笔画与点线，至少在理论上能够把表演者的即兴创作精确付印——否则这些即兴之作**转瞬即逝**。§This may seem in tension with the role of cultural ambassador—how could static objects authentically represent an inherently ephemeral and dynamic practice?—but such a view is itself overly object-focused and neglects how Stevens strove to convey exactly those characteristics of ikaah as a cultural practice.§这似乎与文化大使的角色相悖——静态之物如何能本真地代表一种本质上**转瞬即逝**、充满动感的实践？——但这种看法本身过度聚焦于物，忽视了 Stevens 正是着力传达 ikaah 作为文化实践的这些特质。§§ephemeral art / fame 短暂的艺术 / 名声；ephemerality n. 短暂性；transient / fleeting adj. 短暂的（近义）§反义 eternal / permanent§

30210§episodic§ˌepɪˈsɒdɪk§adj. 分集的；由片段组成的；偶发的；断断续续的§Recognizing those limits, researchers turned to approaches that considered home viewing environments, built-in commercials, and episodic storytelling, as well as to audience studies using ethnographic methods that highlighted viewer participation.§认识到这些局限后，研究者转向另一些思路，把家庭观看环境、内置广告插播与**分集**叙事纳入考量，并采用凸显观众参与的民族志方法做受众研究。§§§§episodic storytelling 分集叙事；episodic memory 情景记忆；episode n. 一集；一个事件；episodically adv. 断断续续地；serial / serialized adj. 连载的（近义）§§

30211§epitomize§ɪˈpɪtəmaɪz§v. 是…的典型；集中体现；成为…的缩影§As epitomized by the house in Calle Pedro Loza in Guadalajara, many of Barragán's first projects integrated traditional Mexican building techniques into Mediterranean designs.§以瓜达拉哈拉 Calle Pedro Loza 的住宅**为代表**，巴拉甘早期的许多项目都把墨西哥传统建造技艺融入了地中海式设计之中。§§§epitome n. 典型、缩影 → epitomize§as epitomized by… 以…为代表§重音在第二音节；别与 epitaph（墓志铭）混§

30212§ethereal§ɪˈθɪəriəl§adj. 轻盈空灵的；超凡脱俗的；似非人间的§To conclude that this approach accounts for the ethereal qualities now synonymous with the Highwaymen aesthetic is tempting but inaccurate, as Hair's methods weren't universally practiced by his affiliates: Harold Newton, for example, painted with greater deliberateness but achieved the same effects.§若就此断言这种方法造就了如今与「公路客」美学划等号的**空灵**气质，固然诱人却不确切：海尔的画法并未被同派画家普遍采用——例如 Harold Newton 下笔更为审慎，却达到了同样的效果。§§§§ethereal qualities 空灵气质§ethereal 出自 ether（以太、上层清气），与 aerial（空中的）义近但不同源§原书错：辨析称 ethereal 与 aerial 同源，实则前者出自希腊语 aithēr（上层清气），后者出自 aēr（空气）

30213§evocative§ɪˈvɒkətɪv§adj. 唤起（感情、记忆）的；引起联想的§Evocative of African sculpture and American and Scandinavian folk art, these portraits feature flat, deliberately oversimplified figures in a vibrant but limited color palette.§这些肖像**令人联想到**非洲雕塑以及美国、斯堪的纳维亚的民间艺术：人物被压平、被刻意简化，配色鲜明却克制。§§§evoke v. 唤起 → evocative adj.§evocative of 令人联想起…§与 provocative（挑衅的）拼写近而义远§

30214§excavate§ˈekskəveɪt§v. 发掘；挖掘；（通过研究）发掘出（事实、证据）§Archaeologist Christiana Kohler and her team excavated the Egyptian tomb of Queen Merneith, the wife of a First Dynasty pharaoh.§考古学家 Christiana Kohler 及其团队**发掘**了埃及王后 Merneith 的陵墓，她是一位第一王朝法老的妻子。§Archaeologist Weiwei Wang and her colleagues analyzed footed grinding slabs and other food-preparation tools excavated from Óc Eo, a Southeast Asian port city that flourished between the first and sixth centuries CE.§考古学家 Wang Weiwei 及同事分析了**出土**自 Óc Eo 的带足磨板等食物加工工具——这是一座于公元一至六世纪兴盛的东南亚港口城市。§§excavate a tomb / site 发掘陵墓 / 遗址；excavation n. 发掘（工作）；excavator n. 挖掘机；发掘者§unearth 偏「使重见天日」§

30215§expressionist§ɪkˈspreʃənɪst§adj. 表现主义的 n. 表现主义艺术家§Turning away from landscapes painted in an expressionist style—a style that often involves using fluid, distorted shapes and thick, textured brushstrokes to express the artist's subjective experience of reality—Johnson began painting portraits of Black Americans in a bold new way.§约翰逊从**表现主义**风景画——那种常以流动扭曲的形体、厚重有肌理的笔触来传达艺术家主观现实体验的风格——转身，转而用一种大胆的新方式描绘美国黑人肖像。§§§§§以变形、粗笔触主观表现内在体验，而非客观再现；常与 impressionist（印象派）对照§

30216§extirpate§ˈekstɜːpeɪt§v. （使物种在某地）灭绝；根除；切除；摘除§To explore this question, scientists seeded restored HZs in Oregon’s Johnson Creek with stoneflies and other locally extirpated species.§为探究这一问题，科学家在俄勒冈州约翰逊溪已修复的潜流带（HZ）投放了石蝇以及其他在当地已**灭绝**的物种。§Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as access to genomic data from extirpated populations, it remains a relatively underutilized resource because hDNA is often to some extent degraded, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.§尽管这种方法有独特优势（例如获取已**局部灭绝**种群的基因组数据），它仍是相对未充分利用的资源：历史 DNA 往往有一定程度的降解，在现行方法论范式与现存 DNA 提取、分析技术下都不易补救。§§locally extirpated species 局部灭绝物种；extirpation n. （局部）灭绝；根除；eradicate v. 根除（近义）§extirpated 指在某地区内消失，extinct 指全球灭绝，生态类文章关键区分§改译文：HZ 指潜流带（hyporheic zone），原译「河边栖息区」不准；改译文2：extirpated 是局部灭绝，原译「已绝种」不准

30217§extraneous§ɪkˈstreɪniəs§adj. 外来的；无关的；不相干的§None of them should be considered extraneous.§它们之中没有任何一项应被视作**无关紧要**。§§§§extraneous information / details 无关信息 / 细节§反义 relevant / pertinent；None of them should be considered extraneous 是排除干扰项的典型措辞§

30218§extrapolate§ɪkˈstræpəleɪt§v. 推断；外推；由已知推及未知§Extrapolating from parasite counts on Pacific herring and seven other fish species collected from Puget Sound from 1880 to 2019, Chelsea Wood et al. found that the abundance of three-host parasites, such as Lecithaster sp., negatively correlated with rising average annual sea temperatures; the abundance of two-host parasites, such as C. parophrysi, was largely stable.§Chelsea Wood 等人依据 1880 至 2019 年采自普吉特海湾的太平洋鲱及另外七种鱼类的寄生虫计数作**外推**，发现三宿主寄生虫（如 Lecithaster sp.）的丰度与年平均海温上升呈负相关，而两宿主寄生虫（如 C. parophrysi）的丰度大体稳定。§§§§extrapolate from 根据…推断；extrapolation n. 外推；推断§与 interpolate（在已知点之间内插）相对；SAT 科学阅读推断题高频词§

30219§falter§ˈfɔːltə(r)§v. 结巴地说；支吾；犹豫；动摇；衰退；蹒跚§They are meeting for the first time. The little girl was standing quite by herself when Nancy finally did approach her. “Are you Miss—Pollyanna?” she faltered.§她们是第一次见面。南希终于走上前去时，那个小女孩正独自一人站着。「你是——波莉安娜小姐吗？」她**迟疑地**问道。§§§§the economy faltered 经济衰退；faltering adj. 犹豫的；摇摇欲坠的；waver / hesitate 动摇 / 迟疑（近义）§与 filter（过滤）形近异义§

30220§feign§feɪn§v. 假装；佯装（伤病、情绪）§While observing birds for a biology class, a group of students noticed a lesser sand plover (Charadrius mongolus), a bird of the order Charadriiformes (shorebirds), slowly move away, make loud noises, and feign an injured wing as the group approached the bird's ground nest.§一节生物课上，学生观察鸟类时注意到一只小沙鸻（Charadrius mongolus，鸻形目涉禽）在人靠近地面巢穴时缓缓走开、大声鸣叫，并**装出**翅膀受伤的样子。§§§§feign an injured wing 装作翅膀受伤；feign injury 拟伤§与 feint（佯攻）同源；动物行为学里 feign injury 是「拟伤诱敌」的固定术语§

30221§foreknowledge§fɔːˈnɒlɪdʒ§n. 预知；事先知道§Researchers investigated how enjoyment of a story is affected when it has been spoiled (when the reader has foreknowledge of an important plot development).§研究者考察了当故事被剧透（读者**事先知道**了某个重要情节发展）时，阅读的乐趣会受到怎样的影响。§But complete foreknowledge of relevant conditions is generally unavailable, suggesting that a state of uncertainty ultimately prevails in which outcomes can be predicted but not definitively foretold.§但对相关条件的完全**预知**通常不可得，这表明最终盛行的是一种不确定状态：结果可以被预测，却无法被断然预断。§fore-（预先）+ knowledge§foreknowledge of 事先知道…；foretell / foretold v. 预言（同族）§foresight 是「远见」，不带「确知」义§

30222§foretell§fɔːˈtel§v. 预言；预示§And despite his popular reputation, García Márquez himself wrote several works of strict realism, including Chronicle of a Death Foretold.§尽管马尔克斯以魔幻现实主义闻名，他本人也写过几部严格意义上的现实主义作品，其中包括《一桩**事先张扬**的凶杀案》。§§§fore-（预先）+ tell§foretold 过去式 / 过去分词（真题见于书名 Chronicle of a Death Foretold）；predict / forebode v. 预测 / 预示（近义）§forecast 偏「（根据数据）预测」§

30223§frugal§ˈfruːɡl§adj. 节俭的；俭省的；（饭菜）简单的§There is no Frigate like a Book To take us Lands away Nor any Coursers like a Page Of prancing Poetry—This Traverse may the poorest take Without oppress of Toll ——How frugal is the Chariot That bears the Human soul.§没有一艘快船能像一本书，带我们驶向远方；也没有任何骏马能像一页诗，载着人腾跃——这趟旅程连最穷的人也负担得起，不必受通行税的盘剥：承载人类灵魂的这辆车辇，是何等**俭省**。§§§§a frugal meal 简单的饭菜；frugality n. 节俭§frugal 是褒义的节俭，parsimonious 是过分吝啬§改例句：诗行换行处漏空格（BookTo、awayNor、PageOf、takeWithout、ChariotThat）；改译文：删去英文没有的注释（frigate、coursers 释义）

30224§furrow§ˈfʌrəʊ§n. 犁沟；沟垄；（额上的）皱纹 v. 犁；（使）皱眉§As he hurried along, eagerly anticipating the moment when he would be at home again among the things he knew and liked, the Mole saw clearly that he was an animal of tilled field and hedge-row, linked to the ploughed furrow, the frequented pasture, the lane of evening lingerings, the cultivated garden-plot.§鼹鼠匆匆赶路、满心盼着回到熟悉可亲的旧物之间，一路忽然看得明白：自己是属于耕地与树篱、与犁过的**沟垄**、常去的牧场、傍晚徘徊的小径和料理过的园圃的动物。§§§§furrow one's brow 皱眉；the ploughed furrow 犁过的沟垄§§改例句：删去句首混入的「Badger's house.」（题干背景残句）；改译文：相应删去「巴杰的家到了。」

30225§gastronomy§ɡæˈstrɒnəmi§n. 美食学；烹饪法；（某地的）美食§However, as researcher Eerang Park and colleagues argue, cities must still create effective marketing strategies to benefit fully from being named a City of Gastronomy.§然而，正如研究者 Eerang Park 及其同事所指出的，城市仍必须制定有效的营销策略，才能充分受益于被命名为**美食**之都。§Many people in Buenaventura’s restaurant industry hoped that food tourism would increase after the city was chosen as City of Gastronomy in 2017.§布埃纳文图拉餐饮业的许多人曾寄望于：2017 年当选「**美食**之都」后，美食旅游会随之增长。§gastro-（胃、食）+ -nomy（…学、法）§City of Gastronomy 美食之都；gastronomic adj. 美食的；gastronome n. 美食家；culinary adj. 烹饪的（近义）§gastric 是「胃的」§改例句2：删去混入的 Text 1 一句和「Text 2:」标签；改译文2：相应删去前半

30226§gravitate§ˈɡrævɪteɪt§v. 被吸引；倾向于；逐渐靠向§In the end, that was the temperament I gravitated toward, too.§说到底，我自己也慢慢**倾向**了那种气质。§§§gravity n. 重力 → gravitate§gravitate toward / to 被吸引而逐渐靠向（某种气质、群体、立场）§比 be attracted to 更含蓄、更书面§

30227§habitable§ˈhæbɪtəbl§adj. 可居住的；适于生存的§Computer models have determined that for potential hycean planets, the range of the habitable zone (HZ), the distance from a star that allows a planet to retain liquid water on its surface, begins at about 1 astronomical unit (AU).§计算机模型已确定，对于潜在的氢海洋行星，**宜居**带（HZ，即行星与恒星之间能使其表面保有液态水的距离范围）的起点大约在1个天文单位（AU）处。§Given the immense scope of space, the search for extraterrestrial life is almost necessarily concentrated on the exoplanets deemed to have the most plausible chance of success—typically, atmosphere-bearing terrestrial planets orbiting within a certain range of their stars (termed the habitable zone).§鉴于宇宙空间浩瀚无垠，对外星生命的探索几乎必然集中于成功可能性最被看好的系外行星——通常是拥有大气、且在恒星一定距离范围内运行（即所谓**宜居**带）的类地行星。§habit-（居住）+ -able§habitable zone (HZ) 宜居带（真题天文类固定术语）；habitability n. 可居住性；habitat n. 栖息地§inhabitable 也是「可居住的」，并非 habitable 的反义词§

30229§helix§ˈhiːlɪks§n. 螺旋（线）；螺旋结构§Delany’s “Time Considered as a Helix of Semi-Precious Stones” (1968) and Beth Cato’s “Apocalypse Playlist” (2020).§Delany 的《被视为半宝石**螺旋**的时间》（1968）与 Beth Cato 的《末日歌单》（2020）。§Delany's "Time Considered as a Helix of Semi-Precious Stones" (1968) and Beth Cato's "Apocalypse Playlist" (2020). In his introduction, Shurin defines cyberpunk as a subgenre of speculative fiction concerning "the influence of technology on the scale, the pace, or the pattern of human affairs"; however, some critics assert that cyberpunk is a literary movement that is in large part aesthetic rather than idea-driven.§Delany 的《时间被视为半宝石的**螺旋**》（1968）与 Beth Cato 的《末日播放列表》（2020）。Shurin 在导言中把赛博朋克定义为关涉「技术对人类事务的规模、节奏或模式之影响」的思辨小说亚类；然而一些批评家断言，赛博朋克在很大程度上是一场美学驱动、而非观念驱动的文学运动。§§double helix 双螺旋（DNA 结构）；helical adj. 螺旋形的；spiral n. 螺旋（近义）§复数 helices，不规则复数，主谓一致易设陷§改译文：删去英文没有的「例如」；改例句2：两处标题引号与年份括号之间漏空格

30230§henceforth§ˌhensˈfɔːθ§adv. 从今以后；今后；从那以后§Vale put her hand to her heart and cried, “Oh, why can’t you remain like this for ever!” This was all that passed between them on the subject, but henceforth Clara knew that she must grow up.§韦尔把手按在胸口喊道：噢，你为什么不能永远这样呢！关于这件事，她们之间只说了这些，但**从那以后**，克拉拉明白自己必须长大了。§§§§hence adv. 因此；由此；thenceforth / thereafter adv. 从那时起（近义）§本义「从今以后」，过去叙事里也指「从那以后」（如本句）；thenceforth 专指「从那时起」；写作一个词§原书错：辨析称 henceforth 只指「从现在起」，但例句本身就是过去叙事里的「从那以后」

30231§hinterland§ˈhɪntəlænd§n. 腹地；内陆地区；（港口的）集散腹地§To investigate the intra-county spatial reorganization that accompanied sectoral shifts during the second wave of industrialization in the United States (a period corresponding to overall population growth), Martin Vogel et al. analyzed census data from 1870 to 1930 for counties that were predominantly rural as of 1870, considering sectoral composition in hinterlands (areas outside cities), incumbent cities (i.e., cities established before 1870), and cities established after 1870.§为了考察美国第二波工业化期间（这一时期总体人口也在增长）伴随产业结构转型而来的县内空间重组，Martin Vogel 等人分析了1870至1930年间那些在1870年以农业为主的县的人口普查数据，并比较了**腹地**（城市以外的地区）、既有城市（1870年前已建制的城市）以及1870年后新建城市的产业结构。§§§§hinterlands 复数（真题以此形出现）；inland / backcountry n. 内陆 / 偏远地区（近义）§hinterland ≠ homeland：后者是「祖国」，形近异义§

30233§husk§hʌsk§n. （谷物、果实的）外壳；种皮；（玉米）苞叶；空壳 v. 剥去…的外壳§Seeking a biodegradable alternative, Waqas Ahmad and colleagues tended otherwise equivalent plots of strawberries mulched with PE sheeting or one of several newsprint pulp–based alternatives: just newsprint pulp (NP), pulp bound with guar gum (GG), or pulp bound with psyllium husk (PH).§为寻找可降解的替代方案，Waqas Ahmad 等人照料了其余条件完全相同的草莓地块，分别覆以 PE 薄膜或几种新闻纸浆基材料：纯纸浆（NP）、瓜尔胶黏合纸浆（GG）、洋车前子**外壳**黏合纸浆（PH）。§At its peak, sweet corn grows a whole inch every single day and as the layers of husk shift slightly to accommodate this expansion, you can hear it as a low continuous rustle if you stand inside the rows of a cornfield on a perfectly still August day.§在生长高峰期，甜玉米每天都要长高整整一英寸；层层**苞叶**随之微微挪动以容纳这种膨胀，如果你在八月里一个全然无风的日子站在玉米地的行垄之间，就能听到一阵低沉而连续的沙沙声。§§psyllium husk 洋车前子壳；corn husk 玉米苞叶§引申为贬义的「空壳、只剩躯壳」§改译文：「洋车前子壳」改作「洋车前子外壳」以便标出 husk；改例句2：删去句末版权残文「◎2016 by A.」；补译文2

30235§impertinent§ɪmˈpɜːtɪnənt§adj. 无礼的；冒失的；（旧）不相干的；不切题的§Finally, and adding much-needed gravitas, was Sir Winston Day, whose features seemed moulded to adorn a bust, or possibly a stamp, and whose forehead was so evidently bulging with grey matter that it would have been impertinent to inquire too closely into the actual achievements his half-century of public service had produced.§最后，同样为场面添上急需的庄重的，是温斯顿·戴爵士：他的相貌仿佛天生就该被塑成半身像、或印上邮票，额头显然鼓胀着灰质，以至于若有人过分细究他半个世纪公职究竟成就了什么，倒显得**唐突失礼**了。§§§§§反义 pertinent 原指「切题的」；真题 it would have been impertinent to inquire 是英式反讽：追问其政绩近乎失礼§

30236§implausible§ɪmˈplɔːzəbl§adj. 不合情理的；难以置信的；不大可能成立的§Based on simulations they conducted, astrophysicists Daniel Whalen, Muhammad Latif, and colleagues concluded that these early quasars developed partly as a result of rare convergences of gases in space without the need for ultraviolet backgrounds or other extreme and implausible environmental conditions that models of the early universe have included to account for the presence of these quasars.§基于所做的模拟，天体物理学家 Daniel Whalen、Muhammad Latif 等人得出结论：这些早期类星体的形成，部分源于太空中气体罕见的汇聚，并不需要早期宇宙模型为解释其存在而设定的紫外背景或其他极端且**难以成立**的环境条件。§§§im- + plausible§§真题 extreme and implausible environmental conditions 用并列形容词强化否定§

30240§infest§ɪnˈfest§v. （害虫、病菌）大量滋生；侵扰；充斥；遍布§Researchers investigated the poor resistance tomato plants show to whitefly herbivory by exposing some plants to airborne chemicals from whitefly‑free plants and others to airborne chemicals from whitefly‑infested plants, then infesting both groups of plants with whiteflies.§研究者考察了番茄植株对粉虱取食表现出较弱抗性的原因：他们把一些植株暴露于无粉虱植株释放的空气化学物质中，另一些暴露于受粉虱侵染植株释放的化学物质中，然后让粉虱**侵染**两组植株。§§§§be infested with 被…侵扰；whitefly-infested plants 受粉虱侵染的植株；infestation n. （害虫）侵扰§infest 是「虫害滋生」，infect 是「感染」§改译文：infesting 是虫害侵染，原译「感染」与本词辨析相矛盾；删例句2：是图表文字的 OCR 乱码，不是句子

30241§infuse§ɪnˈfjuːz§v. 注入；灌输；使充满；浸泡（茶、药）§Biotechnology researcher Lina Haddad and team have developed a tool to restore those cues in damaged reefs: a gel coating infused with metabolites derived from Indian Ocean CCA.§生物技术研究者 Lina Haddad 及其团队开发了一种工具来恢复受损珊瑚礁中的这些线索：一种**注入**了源自印度洋壳状珊瑚藻代谢产物的凝胶涂层。§Lead acetate, however, has a much higher water solubility of 44.31 grams per 100 milliliters, so in an experiment intended to address this issue, researchers infused pure water with sodium acetate, which provides acetate ions that readily bond with lead ions to form lead acetate.§而醋酸铅的水溶性要高得多（每 100 毫升 44.31 克），因此在针对这一问题的实验中，研究者向纯水中**加入**醋酸钠——其提供的醋酸根离子易与铅离子结合生成醋酸铅。§§infuse A with B 把 B 注入 A；infuse the text with humor 使文字充满幽默；infused with metabolites 注入了代谢产物的；infusion n. 注入；浸剂§suffuse 是「弥漫于」，confuse 是「使困惑」，都只是形近§

30246§lament§ləˈment§v. 哀叹；悲叹；为…痛惜 n. 挽歌；悲叹§Though less widely known, Picasso—who once lamented that writers of his time had “limited themselves to moving around words somewhat while respecting the syntax”—also wrote poetry that defied conventional grammar, semantic relationships, and text structure.§尽管鲜为人知，毕加索——他曾**慨叹**自己时代的作家只是把词挪来挪去，同时还要遵守句法——也写过挑战常规语法、语义关系与文本结构的诗。§§§§lament the passing of… 哀叹…的逝去；a lament for the dead 悼亡挽歌；lamentable adj. 令人遗憾的；可悲的；lamentation n. 悲叹；哀悼§lambent 是「（光）轻柔摇曳的」，形近异义§

30248§lark§lɑːk§n. 云雀；嬉戏；玩笑 v. 嬉戏；胡闹§From larks to buzzards, many birds fly in flocks.§从**云雀**到鵟，许多鸟类都成群飞行。§The Song of the Lark, painted in the realist style by Jules Breton, depicts a barefoot peasant woman pausing in the fields at sunset.§《**云雀**之歌》由朱尔·布雷东以现实主义风格绘成，描绘了一位赤脚农妇在日落时分的田野中驻足的情景。§§for a lark 闹着玩；lark about 胡闹§真题 larks 与 buzzards（鵟）对举，泛指各类鸟§

30249§liberalization§ˌlɪbrəlaɪˈzeɪʃn§n. 自由化；（市场、资本）放开管制§The standard view among economists at the time was that liberalization would make it easier for companies to raise money from investors.§当时经济学家的标准看法是，**自由化**会让企业更容易从投资者那里筹资。§In an analysis of economic data from 1976 to 1993, Ross Levine and Sara Zervos found that liberalization did not lead to enduring increases in investment in companies based in countries that liberalized.§在对 1976 至 1993 年经济数据的分析中，Ross Levine 与 Sara Zervos 发现：金融**自由化**并未使自由化国家的本土公司投资出现持久增长。§§economic / trade / market liberalization 经济 / 贸易 / 市场自由化；liberalize v. 使自由化；liberal adj. 自由的；开明的；liberality n. 慷慨；开明§英式拼写 liberalisation，SAT 用美式 -z-§
